issue_context.title: The System.Text.Json source generator doesn't populate `JsonPropertyInfo.AttributeProvider` metadata.
issue_context.body:
The `JsonPropertyInfo.AttributeProvider` property isn't being populated by the source generator, making it impossible to resolve additional attributes from `JsonPropertyInfo` instances. This can create issues when mapping contract metadata to richer representations such as JSON schema (e.g. resolving `DescriptionAttribute`).

cc @captainsafia @stephentoub

@eiriktsarpalis I'm interested how this could affect a JSON Schema representation.  Where does this come from?

@gregsdennis We want to be able to extract a JSON schema from the contract as specified in `JsonTypeInfo` instances. I'm working on a prototype for that [here](https://github.com/eiriktsarpalis/stj-schema-mapper) but at the moment we still need to fall back to reflection to extract some of the necessary information.
Happy to talk about this more offline if you have the time.

review_comments: What if there's more than one?
Is that possible for non-method members? It only looks up ones declared in the current type so it wouldn't include shadowed members.
Good point. I doubt this would create an issue here since indexers are excluded when properties are being populated (cf. method below this one).
(I think it's also possible in IL for two properties to be named the same but have different return values.)
TIL... I had no idea we had an interface for this.
